name: ernestdefoe/curio
description: Members show off what they collect: games, vinyl, books, films, LEGO, cards, anything. Collections with photos, details, wishlists and trades, barcode look-up, and titles and descriptions in every language the forum speaks.

suggest.ernestdefoe/bespoke: Offers Curio's "Recently added" widget on Bespoke's home page.
suggest.ernestdefoe/shelf: Brings members' "In my collection" titles from Shelf into Curio (php flarum curio:import-shelf).
suggest.fof/forum-widgets-core: Offers Curio's "Recently added" widget to FoF Forum Widgets.
suggest.ernestdefoe/marquee: Adds film, TV and game search (TMDB and IGDB) to Curio's look-ups.
suggest.fof/badges: Award badges for items in members' collections and collections made with FoF Badges triggers (^2.0).

scripts-descriptions.test:setup: Sets up a database for use with integration tests. Execute this only once.
